jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

Do you possess an IRATA Level 3 certificate, are you technically skilled, and do you enjoy working at heights? Do you enjoy leading and supervising operational teams, with a keen eye for safety and quality, and do you also like to roll up your sleeves? Do you want to work as a chef in the Netherlands this summer?

Do you have a passion for cooking and do you want to further develop your culinary talent in an inspiring environment? Restaurant De Basiliek in Middelburg is looking for a chef to join our team for the months of June, July, August, and September.

What will you be doing?

You will work together in a team with other Spanish colleagues. From mise en place to preparing dishes during service.

Who are you?

- You have at least 1 year of experience in a professional kitchen and work independently
- You speak English
- You have an eye for detail and present dishes with care
- You love challenges
- You work neatly, are stress-resistant, and think in solutions
- You are flexible and a true team player

About us
De Basiliek is located in Middelburg, a historic city close to the sea. De Basiliek is a beloved spot in our city frequented by many locals as well as tourists. We offer a modern menu with a Spanish touch, where shared dining and the grill set us apart. Quality, taste, and experience are our top priorities. As a cook, you are an important part of this experience.

The employee is employed as a seasonal worker. The employment contract is for 6 weeks to 4 months, at least June, July, August, and September. A fixed working volume averaging 38 hours per week is agreed upon. Working hours may vary per week but are averaged over the duration of the employment contract. More hours may be worked in certain weeks as needed.

Salary: The minimum salary is €2,500 gross per month and depends on education and experience. Salary classification is in accordance with the 2025-2026 Hospitality CLA.

Accommodation is available. Costs amount to €650 including energy, Wi-Fi, etc. It concerns the 2nd floor of a house with shared use of:

• the kitchen
• the toilet
• the bathroom
• the balcony
The bedroom does not need to be shared.

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

•Product and service portfolio evaluation and definition

•Development of trainings and manuals

•Piloting the new concept, preparing for future concept sales

•Mapping end user needs to ensure concept success

To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent.

You have a curious mind and strong analytical skills paired with good technical understanding of wear in practice (maintenance and wear products). As a lot of the future development will have a strong connection to digital tools and systems development, you need an overall understanding of the possibilities that exist within digital development. 

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

As a QA Engineer, you will ensure that the manufacturing applications supporting imec’s world-class research and production environment are reliable, intuitive, and ready for operation.
 
 

• Drive application quality from concept to deployment by preparing and executing functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and user acceptance tests. 

• Partner with users, engineers, and developers to understand business processes, validate requirements, and ensure solutions meet operational needs. 

• Provide clear quality visibility by documenting test results, reporting quality metrics, managing defects, and delivering objective evidence to support deployment and Go/No-Go decisions. 

• Enable successful application adoption through user validation, training support, documentation, and readiness assessments. 

• Champion continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, refining testing practices, and helping raise quality standards across the organization. 

Who you are
 

You are a quality-driven professional who enjoys bridging technology and operations and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
 
 

• Strong expertise in software testing methodologies, including test planning, test design, requirements traceability, defect management, risk-based testing, and user acceptance testing. 

• A solid understanding of quality assurance best practices, with the ability to produce clear test documentation, execution reports, and objective quality assessments that support deployment decisions. If you hold an ISTQB certification, that’s a great bonus, but your mindset matters more. 

• At least 5 years of experience in application testing or QA engineering, preferably for operational, manufacturing, CIM, or MES-related systems. Experience in a manufacturing, semiconductor, or process-industry environment is a strong asset. 

• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, combined with a proactive mindset and the ability to collaborate effectively with both business users and technical teams. Fluency in English is essential.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Mainframe Application Life Cycle Management Specialist to join a strategic project with a leading organisation in Belgium.

The role is primarily focused on Mainframe application development, deployment and lifecycle management. The organisation uses Kobee as its Application Life Cycle Management platform, but previous Kobee experience is not required.

We are therefore particularly interested in candidates with a strong background in Mainframe environments, application lifecycle management, JCL, release management, deployment processes and Mainframe development tooling, who are willing to learn Kobee.
Your responsibilities

• 
Provide technical support to Mainframe application developers.

• 
Analyse and resolve issues related to Mainframe application development and lifecycle management.

• 
Support application build, packaging, deployment and release processes.

• 
Develop, maintain and troubleshoot JCL used in application lifecycle processes.

• 
Support the installation, configuration and upgrade of the Application Life Cycle Management environment.

• 
Automate and optimise Mainframe development and deployment processes.

• 
Work closely with Mainframe developers, application teams and infrastructure teams.

• 
Analyse technical issues across the application lifecycle and identify appropriate solutions.

• 
Improve and standardise development, testing and deployment processes.

• 
Contribute to the evolution of the Mainframe ALM / DevOps environment.

• 
Develop expertise in the organisation's ALM tooling, including Kobee.

We are looking for a hands-on Mainframe professional with solid experience in Mainframe application development and/or Application Life Cycle Management.
Essential experience

• 
Several years of professional experience in a Mainframe environment.

• 
Strong understanding of Mainframe application development and deployment processes.

• 
Good knowledge of JCL and experience creating, maintaining and troubleshooting JCL scripts.

• 
Experience with Mainframe application lifecycle, release or deployment management.

• 
Experience working with Mainframe development or change-management tools.

• 
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• 
Ability to work closely with developers and technical teams.

• 
Comfortable learning new technical tools and environments.

Experience with technologies such as:

• 
JCL, COBOL,CICS, DB2, IMS, z/OS, TSO/ISPF

• 
Mainframe batch processing

• 
Mainframe application deployment and release processes

• Knowledge of Java and Tomcat is a plus.

• Previous Kobee experience is not mandatory.

• Kobee is a specialised Application Life Cycle Management solution used in the organisation's Mainframe environment. The successful candidate will receive the opportunity to develop expertise in Kobee.

• Candidates with strong Mainframe ALM / DevOps experience using other tools 

• You are an experienced Mainframe professional who understands how applications are developed, maintained, tested, packaged and deployed in a Mainframe environment.

• You enjoy troubleshooting complex technical issues, improving processes and working closely with development teams.

• You do not necessarily need to know Kobee. What matters most is your Mainframe expertise, JCL knowledge and understanding of application lifecycle and deployment processes.

jobs.description:
Position: Sales Operations Representative / Order Administrator 

Location: Brecht 

As a Sales Operations Representative / Order Processor, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth order processing and customer satisfaction. You will follow up on orders, report and resolve incidents, and communicate effectively with both customers and internal departments. You will coordinate shipments with factories and be an integral part of the team based in Brecht, handling orders for the US market. 

Primary Duties & Responsibilities: 

 
• Review incoming customer orders for items, pricing, and export license requirements. 
 
• Process sales orders in the ERP system (SAP) using the ESKER tool. 
 
• Process purchase orders at manufacturing plants, if required. 
 
• Follow up on sales orders with manufacturing plants and warehouses to ensure timely delivery. 
 
• Communicate with customers regarding their orders; resolve delivery issues, respond to inquiries, and provide necessary delivery documentation. 
 
• Request export documentation from customers as needed. 
 
• Invoice customers after delivery and monitor customer balances prior to shipment. 
 
• Maintain and closely monitor order backlog. 
 
• Record orders and customer information in internal systems and files. 
 
• Serve as a backup for other Sales Operations Specialists when needed. 

 

• A college Diploma or equivalent required, AS or higher in business preferred. 

• A first experience in Customer service - Order Processing is required. 

• A very good and professional command of English is required. In addition, you also have a good command of German. 

• Ability to communicate effectively: strong written and verbal communication skills. 

• Flexible, easy-going and able to adapt to a fast-paced and sometimes changing environment. 

• Good time management skills with the ability to prioritize, follow-through, and complete tasks on time. 

• Focused and versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure. 

• Detail oriented with high level of accuracy. 

• Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills. 

• Self-motivated and good level of focus/concentration. 

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. 

• Strong computer skills and experience with SAP. 

• You have your own transportation and a valid driving license (difficult to reach by public transport).

jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Weekend Production Operator – Flexible Schedule, Attractive Pay, and Career Growth
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a rewarding and well-paid temporary opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a modern production environment? As a Weekend Production Operator, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient operations for a well-respected company in Kaulille. This temporary role runs from July through September and is ideal for individuals who are available and motivated to work long weekend shifts.

Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. You'll rotate between day and night shifts: one week you'll work from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and the following week from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. You will also be responsible for cleaning equipment, applying HACCP procedures, and stepping in wherever needed on the production floor to support your team.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Commitment to work weekends for the full 3-month period (July–September)
• Availability for both day (6:00 AM–6:00 PM) and night (6:00 PM–6:00 AM) shifts on a rotating basis
• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely
• Suitable for candidates not in full-time weekday employment

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks
